baselineRecovery.limitation: Current baseline recovered from a verified full review. Missing historical weekly inputs and unresolved overlays retain their separate limitations.

researchReview.scope: Sunday pregame sweep across all 28 teams and 14 active Week 4 games still awaiting kickoff, from the verified 2026-10-03T16:57:36-07:00 late-day Delta endpoint through completion. Current availability, replacement, quarterback and weather evidence only; PIT-CLE and the already-started IND-WAS game were excluded and market prices were not viewed.

signConvention.spreadHome: Negative = home favorite; positive = home underdog.
signConvention.gap: Pinnacle home spread minus Graham home fair. Positive = Graham stronger on home; negative = Graham stronger on away.
signConvention.moneylinePair: Displayed as away / home American prices.

personnelEstimateCases.assumptionRationale: Treat Jaylen Warren as the primary handler of Dowdle's additional vacant role because Pittsburgh's official game-day report says Warren will be asked to carry the load.
personnelEstimateCases.precision: Estimated injury loss rounded once to 0.001; subsequent weekly arithmetic is exact.
personnelEstimateCases.limitation: Replacement allocation is a labelled Graham estimate using frozen values. It is not confirmed workload or an empirical confidence interval. QB, playing impairment, displaced roles and unsupported clusters remain separate.
personnelEstimateCases.reopenOn: Pittsburgh changes the active backfield, limits Warren, or reports that another back has assumed the primary additional workload.

personnelEstimateCases.assumptionRationale: Assume equal additional vacant-role duty for Jaylen Wright and Ollie Gordon II, the two active backs on Miami's current official depth chart. Their locked values are identical, so the effective replacement value is allocation-invariant.
personnelEstimateCases.precision: Estimated injury loss rounded once to 0.001; subsequent weekly arithmetic is exact.
personnelEstimateCases.limitation: Replacement allocation is a labelled Graham estimate using frozen values. It is not confirmed workload or an empirical confidence interval. QB, playing impairment, displaced roles and unsupported clusters remain separate.
personnelEstimateCases.reopenOn: Miami names a different primary back, changes Wright or Gordon's availability, documents unequal additional role shares, or adds another running-back absence.
